note: Each arm is the packed plugin with these edits applied to its private copy. The shipped plugin has no switch for turning a part off, so a project's config can never do it. Sizing is gone in 5.0, so it has no factor. Escalation is the choice between signal-fired and always-on review.

review-off.find: const wantsReview = c.reviewed_tree !== tree && (c.next === 'fix' || signals.review.length + signals.security.length > 0 || c.release_candidate);

review-always.find: const wantsReview = c.reviewed_tree !== tree && (c.next === 'fix' || signals.review.length + signals.security.length > 0 || c.release_candidate);

planning-on.find: Do the work in `$ARGUMENTS` yourself, in this thread.
planning-on.replace: First write a short feature-sized plan for `$ARGUMENTS`, with a test or command that proves each milestone, and pipe it to `somi plan`. Then do the work yourself, in this thread.
